items.title: Humana taps ex-Johns Hopkins exec as Medicaid leader
items.summary: James “J.P.” Holland is taking the reins of Humana’s Medicaid business, a key growth area for the company, starting this coming Monday. It’s part of a broader leadership transition announced late last year.

items.title: Humana (HUM) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.summary: CEO Rechtin details Medicare Advantage margin recovery strategy through 2028.

items.title: Humana (HUM) Is Up 5.8% After Cutting 2026 EPS Outlook Amid Strong Q2 And Buybacks
items.summary: In late July 2026, Humana reported higher second-quarter revenue of US$40,867 million and net income of US$694 million, while also confirming completion of a US$276.13 million share repurchase program initiated in February 2024 and announcing two new board appointments, Paul Smith and Frederick Crawford. Despite stronger quarterly results and governance additions, Humana lowered its full-year 2026 GAAP EPS guidance to at least US$6.52 from at least US$8.36, signaling a more cautious outlook...

items.title: UNH Leads Its Peer Group. You Pay For That
items.summary: In the health insurance arena, one company is both the undisputed leader and the most expensive ticket, forcing investors to decide if paying up for quality is a winning strategy.

items.title: Can ALHC's Raised 2026 Outlook Offset Heavier Second-Half Spending?
items.summary: Alignment Healthcare raises its 2026 outlook as membership and medical-cost trends improve, but heavier second-half investments could pressure near-term profitability.

items.title: Is ALHC Stock a Buy as Fast Growth Clashes With Premium Valuation?
items.summary: Alignment Healthcare lifted its 2026 outlook after 31%+ membership and revenue growth, but rich earnings valuation and second-half risks may justify a wait-and-see approach.

items.title: The Case For UnitedHealth Stock Is Margin, Not Growth
items.summary: UnitedHealth's revenue held up; the operating margin on it did not, and closing that gap is the whole upside case.
